title: Half of the weight, not the cards
hook: Some positions carry more voting weight than others.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Select a weighted median by partitioning and accumulating discarded weight.

misconception: The middle card is the median even when cards have unequal weights.
objective: Select a weighted median by partitioning and accumulating discarded weight.

claims.text: The boundary is measured in cumulative weight, not in the number of positions. The first position reaching half the total leaves no more than half the weight strictly to either side.
